repoSummary: A minimal ASP.NET URL shortener: a Core library (ILinkStore, InMemoryLinkStore, ShortCode, UrlValidator), an Api project with POST /links and GET /{code}, and an xUnit test project.

modules.purpose: Unit tests for the store and validation

dependencyFindings: Api depends on Core through the ILinkStore abstraction.
Tests depend on Core and exercise the store directly.

impactAnalysis.proposedChange: Add expiry to Link and an optional expiresAt to ILinkStore.Create
Add click recording and a stats endpoint

refactorings.title: Extend ILinkStore additively rather than replacing it
refactorings.rationale: Preserves the existing abstraction and keeps the current tests valid.

risks.title: Signature change to ILinkStore.Create
risks.description: Adding a parameter could break existing callers or tests.
risks.mitigation: Make expiresAt an optional parameter with a default so existing calls still compile.
